pages.note: William Martin, Beaufort, 23 Aug 1745: sons John, Joel, William, Joseph; daughters Ann and Elizabeth; a cousin John Martin; witnesses John and Mary Alderson. The Bath Martins who kept the name Joel (C14, C18).

pages.book: Hathaway, North Carolina Historical and Genealogical Register, vol. 1
pages.note: A Richard Bryant made road overseer about 1706. Not Nicholas Bryant's family.

pages.name: NC_Hathaway_Register_V1_p0229_Bryant_Carteret.pdf
pages.book: Hathaway, North Carolina Historical and Genealogical Register, vol. 1
pages.note: Thomas Harvey (1748) names a "cousin Sarah Alderson of Beaufort" (Simon's daughter) and John Harrell Jr. a son Bryant. No Bryant family here.

pages.name: NC_Hathaway_Register_V1_p0386_Bryant_Carteret.pdf
pages.book: Hathaway, North Carolina Historical and Genealogical Register, vol. 1
pages.note: A garbled Tyrrell will with grandsons Bryant (1743-1744), and Henry Snead of Beaufort (1752). Not Nicholas Bryant.

pages.book: Grimes, North Carolina Wills and Inventories (1912)
pages.note: David Bailey of Core Sound names his son-in-law Simon Bryant. Another Carteret Bryant; nothing on Nicholas or Eleanor.
